load_embedding_file: load a numpy embedding file using the Embedding class with mmap or memory mode
read_embedding_with_mmap: read embeddings from a .npy file into memory using open_for_read with mmap mode
save_embedding_subset: save a subset of embeddings to a new file in fp16 or fp32 format using Embedding save
concatenate_embedding_files: merge multiple embedding files into one output file using EmbeddingConcatenator as a context manager
create_embedding_header: create a companion .hdr header file for legacy embedding files using create_header
